In every report for this team

  • Corporate modification timeline

What gets in the way today

Manual corporate history assembly

Associates spend hours piecing together name changes, capital increases and registered office moves from fragmented portals.

Hidden conflicts of interest

Cross-directorships and shared promoter ties between opposing parties or deal partners are easy to miss.

Client turnaround pressure

Clients want thorough due diligence reports on very tight deadlines, without any loss of accuracy.

Incomplete litigant backgrounds

It is hard to confirm quickly whether a corporate litigant is in good legal standing, filing regularly or going through restructuring.

Beneficial ownership obscurity

Tracing ultimate beneficial owners through nested shareholding tiers and corporate holdings is slow and uncertain.

Fragmented historical documents

Legal opinions and title certifications need historical statutory returns and board resolution filings that are hard to source.

Data from official company filings Secure payments Encrypted in transit

incoinfo compiles information from public and official sources, including company registry filings (in India, our current coverage: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Registrar of Companies), tax registrations and registered charge records. Reports are provided for reference and due diligence. They reflect each company’s filings up to its latest submission on record and are not investment, credit or legal advice. Verify material facts independently before acting on them.
